content: I’m trying to choose the best license for my project https://prove2.me . For lean code, Apache 2.0 makes sense. But what about human or LLM generated text or comments? I am more familiar with licenses like CC-BY. I wonder how Tau Ceti handles this. Maybe it’s not something I should worry about so much(?)
So I guess in tauceti the only non lean code would be the roadmaps, but those are made here (not taken from other places) and so I'm guessing they are under the same licence.
